content.heading: Assign salesperson while creating invoices and bills
content.description: Giddh provides a Salesperson feature that allows users to assign a salesperson while creating invoices and bills. This helps businesses track transactions based on the individual responsible for generating the sale.

content.heading: Associate transactions with a salesperson
content.description: Users can select the relevant salesperson during invoice or bill creation, ensuring that every transaction is properly associated with a specific person. This makes it easier to monitor individual performance and maintain accurate sales records.
more_content: Every transaction linked to a person

content.heading: Salesperson Report by time period
content.description: Giddh also provides a Salesperson Report, which allows users to analyse sales performance over different time periods, such as daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly. The report helps businesses identify how much sales each salesperson has generated during the selected period.

faqs.question: What is the Salesperson feature in Giddh?
faqs.answer: Giddh provides a Salesperson feature that allows users to assign a salesperson while creating invoices and bills. This helps businesses track transactions based on the individual responsible for generating the sale.

faqs.question: When do I assign a salesperson?
faqs.answer: You can select the relevant salesperson during invoice or bill creation, so every transaction is properly associated with a specific person.

faqs.question: Why assign a salesperson to a transaction?
faqs.answer: It makes it easier to monitor individual performance and maintain accurate sales records.

faqs.question: What is the Salesperson Report?
faqs.answer: Giddh provides a Salesperson Report that allows users to analyse sales performance over different time periods, such as daily, weekly, monthly, or yearly.

faqs.question: What does the Salesperson Report show?
faqs.answer: The report helps businesses identify how much sales each salesperson has generated during the selected period.

faqs.question: Does this work on both invoices and bills?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can assign a salesperson while creating invoices and bills in Giddh.
